editorial:
You follow two conspiracy-obsessed young men who kidnap a powerful CEO because they believe she is an alien planning to destroy Earth. The setup is strange, tense, and darkly funny, with most of the story trapped in a basement standoff. Emma Stone plays the CEO with cool control, while Jesse Plemons makes the lead kidnapper feel both dangerous and oddly sad. Their back-and-forth keeps you guessing about who is really in charge. The movie mixes sci-fi paranoia, thriller pressure, and sharp comedy without losing its weird edge.

The acting is the biggest draw, and the pacing stays tight enough to keep you hooked. Some scenes are uncomfortable, and the humor can be very dark, so it may not be for everyone. If you enjoy odd thrillers with big twists, this is worth your time.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Michelle reveals she is actually an alien and escapes the basement. Teddy realizes his theory was right, but his violent plan has already gone too far. She returns to her ship, judges humanity too destructive, and triggers a mass extinction. The last moments show Earth emptied of people while the bees keep thriving, ending on a bleak but darkly funny note.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves strange thrillers, dark comedy, and big twists.
